sloka: सर्वे सुकृत कर्माणः सर्वे रति परायणाः ।सर्वे काम अर्थ सहिता वसंति सह योषितः ॥४-४३-५०॥
transliteration: sarve sukṛta karmāṇaḥ sarve rati parāyaṇāḥ ।sarve kāma artha sahitā vasaṁti saha yoṣitaḥ ॥4-43-50॥

translations.english: 'Some trees bring forth many good quality drinks, eatables and also virtuous women, young and beautiful.
